name: code-server
description: VS Code in the browser, running on this server with its own home directory. Everything the editor installs — extensions, settings, repositories — lives in the volume.

access.note: code-server has no user accounts. The generated value of PASSWORD is the whole credential: the first visit redirects to /login, which is a single password box, and you paste it there. Logins are rate-limited to two per minute plus twelve per hour, and anyone holding that one value gets a full editor and terminal inside the container.

inputs.description: The editor is only published through the proxy, so this is the address it answers on.
